title: Special repair and maintenance of Armagaon Lighthouse along with construction of Security Guard cabin and beautification of the station
summary: E-tender (percentage rate, two-cover) for special repair and maintenance of Armagaon (Armagon) Lighthouse, Nidigurthi, Nellore District, Andhra Pradesh, with construction of a security guard cabin and beautification of the station (Visakhapatnam Directorate).

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Visakhapatnam

sites.name: Armagaon Lighthouse, Nidigurthi (Post), Via Mallam, Nellore (District) - 524403
sites.work: Special repair and maintenance, construction of security guard cabin, beautification of station

scope.item: Special repair and maintenance of Armagaon Lighthouse along with construction of Security Guard cabin and beautification of the station

money.notes: Estimated cost including GST and all other taxes. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Visakhapatnam, valid three months from technical bid opening; EMD explicitly not exempted for any bidder (including NSIC/MSME) because of past delays; forfeited if bid timelines not followed. Tender fee Nil.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of tender

eligibility: Valid civil registration in appropriate category & class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies, and valid electrical licence
Similar works in last seven years: three each >= 40%, two each >= 50%, or one >= 80% of estimated cost; completion certificates; value updated at 7% p.a.
Similar works: construction, repair and maintenance of buildings and other civil structures including electrical works
PAN and GST registration; key technical personnel; unconditional tender undertaking (Annexure V); tender acceptance letter (Annexure IV); non-blacklisting affidavit
Income tax returns for last three years; average annual turnover of last three financial years minimum 30% of estimated cost
List of relatives serving in MoPSW/DGLL; detailed activity chart/plan; self-assessed technical evaluation sheet
notes: Extract of Section I (printed pages 3-7 of a 99-page tender document); no BOQ. Bid download/submission 04.07.2024 18:00 to 25.07.2024 15:00; pre-bid 11.07.2024 11:00; opening 26.07.2024 15:00. Heavy vehicles permitted to site; damage to pathway tiles/paver blocks/plants to be repaired by contractor. No time extension for document submission. Spelled 'Armagaon' (station list: Armagon).
